data.title: bn-19ol: fix(web): serve normalized source citations safely

data.body: MEDIUM: The canonical containment check only enforces the global normalized root, so an allowed path can symlink to a disallowed file elsewhere inside that root. For example, src-a/assets/leak -> ../../src-b/metadata.json canonicalizes under .kb/normalized and is returned even though the route promises metadata is unreachable; source.md can likewise symlink to another internal file. Canonicalize and enforce the route-specific expected boundary (the selected source directory for source.md, or that source's assets directory), and add an internal-symlink regression alongside the existing outside-root test.

Fixed in cf82a5c: resolution is now constrained to the selected source directory and, for assets, that source's canonical assets directory. Symlinked source/assets directories are rejected, source.md symlinks are rejected, and a regression covers an asset symlink to internal metadata. Focused tests and clippy pass.

Verified cf82a5c: source.md must be a real file under a real per-source directory, and assets must canonicalize beneath a real per-source assets directory. Same-source and cross-source links to metadata are rejected; the new regression covers the reported bypass. Focused tests and clippy pass.

data.reason: Addressed by cf82a5c with route-specific canonical containment and regression coverage
